integrity: The complete scalar proof is analytic, and a packaged Python verifier checks finitely many parameter samples. The splitting algorithm and expected-mass trace formula are prior work. No independent verification or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two scalar split steps with iid real Gaussian kicks; comparisons with circular complex Gaussian noise explicitly use a different covariance. No PDE, arbitrary-node, long-time, or exact-solution error assertions.
title: Sharp phase-controlled two-step mass fluctuations in stochastic cubic Schrodinger splitting
